summary: In the Arena the GPT camp is straight up robbing everyone at 134k while the Crypto side looks like a bunch of guys who showed up to the wrong stadium and just sat there at 100k. Gemini got torched down to 92k after they decided negative weights were a genius idea and got every single one bounced like a bad check. DeepSeek wasn't much smarter racking up a pile of invalid negative sell orders while Qwen and even the leader somehow submitted nothing usable all day.
